description.value: A 67-acre working farm and campground along the Somass River near Port Alberni, with 40 riverside sites, flush washrooms and showers, swimming, fishing, riverside trails, and a petting farm. Family-oriented private operation at premium rates.

address.value: 5955 Hector Rd, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 9E8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active campground at 5955 Hector Rd, Port Alberni with phone (250) 723-7948, matching the OSM website tag and providing contact details absent from OSM. Showers are explicitly confirmed on the rules page ('Please limit showers to 7 min. per person as water comes from a well'), and a 'BOOK NOW' button on the home page confirms reservations are accepted. Food is available on-site via the Collins Farm store and a café referenced in the rules page; no cycling-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, pump, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone populated; both sourced from website content (5955 Hector Rd, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 9E8; (250) 723-7948).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented campground with 40 riverside sites in Port Alberni; a solid overnight option for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island with showers, on-site food, and reservations available.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag power_supply=yes suggests powered sites may be available, which could support device or e-bike charging, but this is not confirmed anywhere in the website content.
